steps.title: Home
steps.summary: Landing page for the androsec assessment workspace.
steps.detail: Introduces the King Saud University graduation project: local APK assessment with static and dynamic analyzers, MASVS-mapped reports, and AI-assisted exploitation that stays on this machine. From here the user starts an assessment or reviews what the framework can run.

steps.title: Assessment — choose an APK
steps.summary: Upload or select a lab APK, then analyze or decompile.
steps.detail: The Assessment library lists sample APKs shipped with the repo (DIVA, InsecureBankv2, UnCrackable, …) plus any uploads. Users pick a target, then continue to analyzer selection or start a decompile.

steps.title: Analyzer selection
steps.summary: Choose static and optional dynamic tools before the scan.
steps.detail: Static analyzers are selected by default. Dynamic checks stay off until the user enables them and authorizes a connected device. Bulk controls (select static / all / clear) speed up configuration.
notes: Demo scan analyzers: apk_info, manifest, permission, component, secret_detector, static_code, storage, network

steps.title: Scan progress
steps.summary: Live progress while each analyzer runs against the APK.
steps.detail: The scanning board shows percent complete, elapsed time, and a per-tool checklist. When the job finishes, the UI navigates to the HTML security report for that run.

steps.title: Security report
steps.summary: Evidence-backed HTML report with PDF download.
steps.detail: The report summarizes findings, severity, and MASVS mapping. A sticky bar offers PDF download. Individual findings can open the AI Exploit workflow with the finding payload and scan metadata.

steps.title: Device readiness
steps.summary: Connect and authorize a phone or emulator for dynamic checks.
steps.detail: Dynamic analyzers require adb on PATH and a ready serial. The page lists connected devices, supports TCP/IP connect, install/root helpers, and blocks dynamic scans until authorization is confirmed.

steps.title: AI exploit & evidence
steps.summary: Grounded PoC planning for a single finding (BYOK).
steps.detail: Opened from a live report finding. The operator pastes an API key (used only for that request), acknowledges lab responsibility, and runs a grounded ADB/Frida PoC pipeline with an evidence gate and optional exploitation PDF.
notes: Opened via finding link from the live report.

steps.title: Decompile workspace
steps.summary: apktool + jadx decode, browse, and rebuild.
steps.detail: Started from Assessment. While decoding, the page shows live status; when done, users browse resources or Java sources and can rebuild the APK from the apktool project.
notes: Decompile UI gap: job did not start (tools missing or validation failed). Assessment page captured instead. apktool is not installed.
